Load 6: the type-$04 vector in the split tables at $7EDF/$7F0F selects this entry. Read state $1AB1,X into Y, use the low and high tables at $B0EC/$B0F2 to patch the jump at $B0E9, and jump to its selected handler. No local bounds check limits the state; only six table pairs are captured here.

Six captured low bytes of handler addresses, paired with high bytes at $B0F2. The pairs target $B0F8, $B125, $B1B8, $B1D7, $B15D, $B18B. State index bounds and handler reachability are open.

Load 6, state 0: if $19B2,X is nonzero, call $3020 and select $FC when its negative flag is set, otherwise $00. If $19B2,X is zero, call $71DB, patch the immediate operand at $B110 with returned X, restore the entity index from A, and select $FC when $6F3C is below returned X, otherwise $00. Store the selected value at $1AD3,X, call $B217, set $1AB1,X to 1 and return. The called routine updates a frame value; ordinary-play reachability remains open.
